# Buyer Quirk Sheet — Statistics South Africa (Stats SA)

**Buyer:** Statistics South Africa (national department, PPPFA/PPR 2022 organ of state)
**Kind:** National department — statistical services, publications, corporate/facilities procurement
**Packs sampled:** 10 — ocds-9t57fa-164492, ocds-9t57fa-165703, ocds-9t57fa-165087, ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165770, ocds-9t57fa-165212, ocds-9t57fa-164999, ocds-9t57fa-164527, ocds-9t57fa-165834, ocds-9t57fa-165838
**Date:** 2026-08

**Note on the corpus:** most sampled packs are national Standard Bidding Documents (SBD1, SBD4, SBD6.1) that are largely boilerplate common to any PPPFA organ of state — ocds-9t57fa-164492/165212/164999/164527 (SBD6.1 preference-points form) and ocds-9t57fa-165087/164658/165834/165838 mostly duplicate the same standard text. The two documents with buyer-specific operational language are the SBD1 invitation-to-bid (ocds-9t57fa-165703, tender STATS SA 005/26) and two Stats SA quotation (RFQ) packs (ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165087). Findings below are drawn from those, with boilerplate sections noted as such.

---

## Submission channel & rules

Two different channels are used depending on procurement type, and the tender-level SBD1 pack contains an internal inconsistency worth flagging to bidders:

- **RFQs (quotations) are email-only.** Both quotation packs are explicit: "All quotations must be emailed to quotations@statssa.gov.za" (ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165087). Late-response protocol is also email-based: "If you are unable to provide a quotation kindly furnish reasons for the non-response in writing, using the quotations@statssa.gov.za email address" (same two ocids). Quotes must be "on the company letterhead" and reference "the CSD Master registration number (MAAA) and tax compliance status PIN" (ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165087).
- **Tenders (SBD1) show a bid-box/email contradiction.** The invitation header names a physical drop point: "BID RESPONSE DOCUMENTS MAY BE DEPOSITED IN THE BID BOX SITUATED AT (STREET ADDRESS) ISIBALO HOUSE, KOCH STREET, SALVOKOP" — but the governing terms clause immediately overrides this with an email-only rule: "1.1. BIDS MUST BE DELIVERED BY THE STIPULATED TIME TO THE CORRECT EMAIL ADDRESS. LATE BIDS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED FOR CONSIDERATION" (ocds-9t57fa-165703). No specific submission email address is filled in on this template copy, and no sealing/labeling/envelope instructions accompany either clause. Practical read: treat the numbered Part B clause (email, hard cutoff) as the operative rule, but confirm the live address/channel with the bid office before submitting, since the header still advertises a bid box.
- **No hard-copy-governs or dual-channel reconciliation rule was observed** — the pack does not state which channel controls if both are used, only that the bid-box mention and the email mandate coexist in the same document.
- **Sealing/labeling conventions:** Not observed in sampled packs (no envelope, marking, or two-envelope-system language found).

## Municipal-arrears / rates clause

Not observed in sampled packs. No mention of municipal rates, property arrears, or a "not more than X days in arrears" clause appears in any of the 10 documents searched (SBD1, SBD4, SBD6.1, and both RFQs).

## B-BBEE treatment

**Preference points only — no hard pre-qualification gate.** Stats SA applies the standard PPR 2022 80/20 (contracts up to R50m) / 90/10 (above R50m) points system, with 80 points for price and 20 for specific goals under 80/20 (ocds-9t57fa-164492, ocds-9t57fa-165770, ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165087): "The maximum points for this tender are allocated as follows: PRICE 80, SPECIFIC GOALS 20, Total points for Price and SPECIFIC GOALS 100" (ocds-9t57fa-165770).

Specific-goals allocation is consistent across the sampled tender and RFQ packs: Black 10, Women 5, Disabled 2, Youth 3 (ocds-9t57fa-164492: "Black 10 ... Woman 5 ... Disabled 2 ... Youth 3"; same table in ocds-9t57fa-164658 and ocds-9t57fa-165087). Failure to submit proof simply forfeits those points rather than disqualifying the bid: "Failure on the part of a tenderer to submit proof or documentation required in terms of this tender to claim points for specific goals with the tender, will be interpreted to mean that preference points for specific goals are not claimed" (ocds-9t57fa-165770).

**RFQ-specific quirk — strict 6-month certification-date rule with automatic zero-scoring (not outright disqualification):** "The Commissioner of Oath stamp on all certified copies (ID'S, CIPC, valid BBBEE certificate or Sworn Affidavit must be dated within 6 months of the quotation closing date. Any document with a certification date older than 6 months or missing certification date, stamp entirely and signature will be rejected as invalid and the supplier will automatically lose points and score zero for than specific goal" (ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165087).

## Cure/condonation policy

Not observed in sampled packs. No clause distinguishing fatal vs. curable defects, and no condonation procedure for late or non-compliant documents was found (RFQ language instead treats missing/aged certification as automatic zero-scoring — see B-BBEE section — rather than as a curable defect).

## Security/vetting requirements

Not observed in sampled packs. No post-award security vetting, integrity pact, or POPIA consent clause appears; the only integrity-adjacent control present is the standard national SBD4 bidder's disclosure common to all organs of state — automatic disqualification if "listed in the Register for Tender Defaulters and/or the List of Restricted Suppliers" (ocds-9t57fa-165834, ocds-9t57fa-165838, ocds-9t57fa-165087, ocds-9t57fa-164658) — which is boilerplate, not Stats SA-specific.

## Financial demands

Not observed in sampled packs — no insurance-level requirement, no bank guarantee/rating letter, and no audited-financials requirement appear in any of the 10 documents (the only hit on "insurance" is the SBD6.1 boilerplate definition of "all applicable taxes," which includes "unemployment insurance fund contributions" — unrelated to project insurance).

**Payment term (RFQ):** "Stats SA will not provide upfront payment; however, payment will be made upon receipt of goods/services and within 30 days of receiving a valid invoice" (ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165087).

## Functionality norms

Not observed as a scored threshold in sampled packs. Only the standard definition appears — "'Functionality' means the ability of a bid to provide goods or services in accordance with specifications as set out in the bid documents" (ocds-9t57fa-164492, ocds-9t57fa-165770) — with no minimum-score threshold, weighting table, or criteria breakdown given in these particular packs. (Both sampled RFQs are straight 80/20 price + specific-goals evaluations with no functionality stage mentioned at all.)

## Distinctive kill rules / quirks

- **Bid-box vs. email contradiction on the SBD1 header** (see Submission channel above) — a distinctive internal inconsistency in Stats SA's tender template that bidders should query before relying on either channel (ocds-9t57fa-165703).
- **Stacked broad-discretion clauses on RFQs**, more numerous than typical: "Stats SA reserves the right not to make an award," "reserves the right not to procure certain items or all items as listed on the request for quotation," "reserves the right to negotiate prices with the successful supplier," and "reserves the right to award partially to specifications required" all appear together in the same RFQ conditions block (ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165087).
- **Lowest price is explicitly not determinative even for simple RFQs:** "The appointment of the service provider will not necessarily be based on the lowest received quotation" (ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165087).
- **Non-responsiveness trigger for slow replies to buyer follow-ups:** "Stats SA may request additional information upon receipt of the quotation and bidder must abide to timeframe given. Failure which the quote may be regarded as non-responsive" (ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165087) — no specific timeframe is stated in the pack itself, so the deadline is buyer-communicated on the fly rather than pre-published.
- **CSD registration is a hard prerequisite for RFQ responders:** "Suppliers responding to quotation should be registered on Central Supplier Database (CSD)" (ocds-9t57fa-164658, ocds-9t57fa-165087), alongside a required CSD Master registration number (MAAA) format quoted with the quotation reference.
